title: Harness of Minervini v2 watchlist.annotate response

examples: scripts/.venv/bin/python scripts/pipeline watchlist annotate AAPL --note 'pivot confirmation still pending'

as_of.description: Completed US trading session in YYYY-MM-DD form; defaults to the latest completed regular session.

format.description: Output detail only; compact preserves verdict, signals, and missing evidence while omitting verbose basis rows.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol with an existing record.

limitations: A note cannot create the first research record; use watchlist record first.
--as-of stamps the command envelope and does not rewrite the original research date.
x-capability-contract.output: The updated latest record and appended history event.
side_effects: Updates the ignored local SQLite ledger.

status_meanings.needs_input: The note is empty or no record exists for the ticker.

x-capability-contract.summary: Append an explicit note to the latest recorded research item for a ticker.
